# qtbpqaprs

**G8BPQ's Qt APRS client, the messaging-focused one**

- **Version recorded:** 00.13
- **Categories:** `packet`, `tracking`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/g8bpq/QtBPQAPRS>

## What it does

An APRS client that connects to a BPQ node (or APRS-IS) and focuses on the messaging half of APRS -- station list, message exchange, beacons -- with a map view fed by an internet tile server.

## Why you would want it

Xastir and YAAC are mapping-first; this is messaging-first, and it is the APRS front end designed to sit on the linbpq node this catalog already configures. If your APRS use is "exchange messages over the local network node", this is the shortest path.

## Before it will work

A running linbpq node with its APRS component enabled, or an APRS-IS account for internet-only use. Nothing touches the radio directly; RF access arrives through the node.

  - the project's build system has no install rule; the binaries listed below are copied into the prefix instead

## Known problems

The build emits sprintf truncation warnings (upstream C in a Qt shell); they do not fail the build and are upstream's to fix. Map tiles need internet access; there is no offline tile store.

## Keeping it current

- probe: github tags (`g8bpq/QtBPQAPRS`)
- strategy: rebuild
- G8BPQ tags releases irregularly. Check alongside linbpq updates -- they are designed to move together.
